old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-1qt2","title":"Do not expose mutable TrustEntry security state to callers","description":"P1 security: TrustStore.get(), verify_or_pin(), verify_peer(), add_trust_anchor(), rotate_key(), and list_entries() return the same mutable TrustEntry objects stored internally. Callers can then replace pubkey/IID/address, lower/raise trust_level, clear revoked, or mutate metadata without any derivation, authorization, rotation-signature, or persistence path; even a frozen store facade would be bypassed. Keep validated primitives private and return immutable detached views/copies, centralize all mutations behind checked methods, and add tests that attempted facade/nested metadata mutation cannot alter verification outcomes.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T15:56:07.275712Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T15:56:07.275712Z"}

new_value: Verified no hole exists: every accessor returns replace(entry) detached copies, TrustEntry is frozen with MappingProxyType-copied metadata, store mutations only via checked methods. Added 6 encapsulation regression tests pinning detached-copy identity, frozen writes, replace/revoke immunity, metadata proxy immutability, caller-dict aliasing break, forged-key rejection. 64/64 test_trust tests pass. Bead premise disproven with evidence; tests are the deliverable.
